plugins.name: CoolROM
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: BROWSER-ASSISTED. There is no standalone provider yet; ROMarr Capture indexes metadata from CoolROM pages the operator opens in Brave/Chromium.
plugins.terms: The standalone repository fetches and redistributes nothing. Browser capture reads metadata only from a page the operator opened and grants no rights to download or redistribute the site's files.
plugins.comments: The server-side survey stopped at robots.txt, which names anthropic-ai and Claude-Web with Disallow: /. The accepted path is now the operator's browser: Capture has preview-first detail/list descriptors, makes no request to CoolROM, and never crawls. The detail matcher follows the long-standing /roms/<platform>/<id>/<title>.php shape; selectors remain provisional until checked in an operator session.
